opening.argument: The presentation describes a structured membership opportunity tied to digital-currency participation, including a founder position made up of “pool 1, pool 2, pool 3” and claims that participants are “actually mining Bitcoin.” It further links continuing payouts to “all the people in your downline” and “all of their repurchases,” while projecting that Clubcoin could reach “ten or twenty dollars for one club coin.” Together with the stated conversion of Bitcoin into Clubcoin, a claimed value floor, free Clubcoin, and limited access, these features present participation as a route to mining-related returns. Payment, delivery, projections, and actual returns remain unestablished, but the described structure supports the classification.
